title: 内存水位增长来源追查：meminfo、vmstat、slab、dma-buf、memcg
key_conclusions: Waterline drops become actionable only when aligned with PSI windows that prove memory stalls.
meminfo identifies the dominant global bucket, while vmstat explains reclaim, refault, swap, and scan mechanics.
slabinfo, dma-buf debugfs, and memcg are required to move from global symptoms to owner evidence.
A fix is proven only when the growing bucket and PSI total growth both fall in the same workload window.
shallow_points: The article does not include real synchronized meminfo, vmstat, slabinfo, dma-buf, and memcg samples from devices.
It does not validate memcg paths across cgroup v1, cgroup v2, and vendor Android kernels.
It does not quantify bucket-specific thresholds for low, mid, and high RAM devices.
It does not include a worked incident with exact before/after deltas.
discovered_connections: Day 52's PSI model becomes the time filter for Day 53 bucket attribution.
Day 49 reclaim counters and Day 50 watermarks explain why a bucket increase can become pressure.
Graphics and dma-buf evidence from Days 46 and 47 must be joined with system waterline evidence.
memcg narrows app responsibility, but shared buffers still need producer-consumer ownership checks.
suggest_future_topics: Day 54 should connect PSI and vmpressure inputs to lmkd kill strategy and property controls.
Day 57 should show how lmkd logs and statsd preserve the victim-side evidence after a kill.
Day 61 should build a synchronized low-memory lab that samples PSI, meminfo, vmstat, slabinfo, dma-buf, and memcg.
Day 68 should revisit native/system attribution with smaps, showmap, heapprofd, and memcg cross-validation.
knowledge_gaps: Need real low-end device samples for slab and dma-buf growth under camera, video, and WebView workloads.
Need Android version validation for dma-buf debugfs availability and access permissions.
Need practical bucket thresholds that separate normal cache growth from kill-risk pressure.
Need automated scripts to align PSI timestamps with meminfo and vmstat deltas.
applied_reflections: Applied Day 52's next-run instruction by focusing on meminfo, vmstat, slab, dma-buf, and memcg waterline attribution.
Applied Day 52's PSI model by making PSI avg windows the first step before any bucket diagnosis.
Applied Day 51's jank evidence requirement by requiring before/after pressure and bucket reduction rather than static screenshots.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using four Mermaid diagrams, compact matrices, command templates, and today's checklist.
visible_changes: Added four Mermaid diagrams because of the more-diagrams-less-prose feedback: bucket attribution structure, PSI-to-bucket sequence, troubleshooting decision flow, and evidence closure path.
Added tables for evidence responsibilities, PSI windows, bucket attribution, source paths, and conclusion closure.
Added a today's checklist requiring PSI windows, meminfo diffs, vmstat deltas, slabinfo top caches, dma-buf owners, memcg responsibility, and before/after validation.
